en: separating the deed from the person
why did I do it again

zh: 听起来，这更像是一股{{name}}。你觉得准吗？叫它别的也行。
en: This sounds more like {{name}}. Does that fit? You can call it something else.

zh: 我读到的是{{name}}——如果我读错了，你改一个词就行。
en: What I read is {{name}}. If I read it wrong, give me another word.

zh: 不是你脾气差，是有什么东西顶到你了。
en: This is not a temper problem. Something pushed against you.

zh: 它会升上来，说明这件事对你不是无所谓。
en: That it rises at all means this matters to you.

zh: {{name}}常常是在说有一条边界被越过了。这一次，被越过的可能是「{{need}}」那条线。
en: {{name}} often says that a boundary was crossed. This time the line may be {{need}}.

zh: 如果把它翻译成一句「我需要……」，会是哪一个词？
en: If you turned it into one sentence starting with I need, which word would it be?

zh: 这件事里，真正被碰到的那条线是什么？
en: In this, which line was actually crossed?

zh: 先给身体一个出口：把想说的话写下来，先不发。等心率降下来再决定要不要表达。
en: Give your body an exit first: write down what you want to say, and do not send it yet. Decide whether to say it once your heart rate comes down.

zh: 这听起来是{{name}}。你觉得准吗？叫它别的也行。
en: This sounds like {{name}}. Does that fit? You can call it something else.

zh: 被忽略的付出也是付出，它不是矫情。
en: Effort that went unseen is still effort. This is not oversensitivity.

zh: 你已经把该做的做了，没被看见不等于没发生。
en: You already did what you were supposed to do. Unseen does not mean it did not happen.

zh: {{name}}常常指向「{{need}}」这个需要，也常和愤怒叠在一起——愤怒对外，{{name}}对内。
en: {{name}} often points to the need for {{need}}, and it often stacks with anger: anger faces outward, {{name}} faces inward.

zh: 在这件事里，你最希望被谁看见哪一部分？
en: In this, who do you most want to see which part of you?

zh: 如果不用「没事」把那句话咽回去，你原本想说的是什么？
en: If you had not swallowed it by saying it is fine, what did you originally want to say?

zh: 把「我其实希望……」写成一句完整的话。只写给自己看，不用发给任何人。
en: Write what I actually hoped for as one full sentence. It is for you only, and you do not need to send it to anyone.

zh: 我读到的是{{name}}——也可能是紧张。你觉得哪个更准？
en: What I read is {{name}}, though it may be tension. Which fits better?

zh: 慌的时候，人会被「还没发生的事」拽着走。这不是你胆小。
en: When panic hits, a person gets dragged along by things that have not happened yet. This is not cowardice.

zh: {{name}}擅长替人预测未来，把还没发生的事当成已经发生。它想做的常常是保护，只是容易做过头。
en: {{name}} is good at predicting the future for you and treating what has not happened as if it had. What it wants is usually to protect you. It just tends to overdo it.

zh: 你在担心的那件事，最坏的结果具体长什么样？它真发生的可能性有多大？
en: The thing you are worried about: what does the worst outcome actually look like, and how likely is it really?

zh: 把「我在担心什么」写成一句完整的话之后，它还是一团雾吗？
en: After you write what I am worried about as one full sentence, is it still a fog?

zh: 说出 5 样看得见的、4 样摸得到的、3 样听得到的东西，把注意力从预测拉回此刻。
en: Name 5 things you can see, 4 you can touch, and 3 you can hear. It pulls attention back from predicting to this moment.

zh: 听起来是{{name}}。这种时刻值得被看清楚一点。
en: This sounds like {{name}}. A moment like this deserves a closer look.

zh: 真好，这种时刻值得被记下来——不是因为要正能量，是因为它有用。
en: It is good. A moment like this is worth writing down, not for the sake of positivity, but because it is useful.

zh: 正向情绪也有信息：它在标记「这件事对我有意义」。值得看清是哪一部分让你{{name}}，而不是一笔带过。
en: Positive feelings carry information too: they mark this as something that matters to you. It is worth seeing which part made you {{name}}, rather than glossing over it.

zh: 这件事里，最让你{{name}}的是哪一小部分？
en: Which small part of this made you {{name}} the most?

zh: 如果把它再做一次，你最想保留的是哪个条件？
en: If you did it again, which condition would you most want to keep?

zh: 把它写进今天的记录里，哪怕只一句。以后低气压的时候，你会需要看到今天这一页。
en: Write it into today's entry, even if it is only one line. On a low day you will need to see this page.

zh: 听起来这几天是{{name}}压着你。你觉得准吗？
en: It sounds like {{name}} has been weighing on you these days. Does that fit?

zh: 它不需要马上被赶走，先让它有个地方待着就好。
en: It does not need to be pushed away right now. Letting it have a place to sit is enough for now.

zh: {{name}}有时是在把决策窗口关小、挡掉几个冲动的选择；也可能只是身体在要休息。
en: {{name}} sometimes narrows the decision window and blocks a few impulsive choices. It may also just be your body asking for rest.

zh: 如果{{name}}能说话，它想替你推掉哪件事？
en: If {{name}} could speak, which thing would it want to take off your plate?

zh: 今天有没有一小会儿，它是松一点的？
en: Was there a short moment today when it eased up a little?

zh: 说一件今天让你稍微松一点的小事——哪怕只是水喝够了。
en: Name one small thing today that let you loosen a little, even if it is only that you drank enough water.
What I read is {{name}}, not laziness.

zh: 累到这个份上，不是靠意志力能顶过去的。这里缺的不是决心，是账。
en: At this level of tiredness, willpower will not carry you through. What is missing here is not resolve, it is the balance.

zh: {{name}}常常是账本上的欠额，不是毅力问题。先把最基础的三样补上，比对自己提要求更有用。
en: {{name}} is usually a deficit on the ledger, not a problem of will. Restoring the three basics first helps more than demanding more from yourself.

zh: 如果把「我应该……」换成一个更小的版本，它会是什么？
en: If you swapped I should for a smaller version, what would it be?

zh: 最近哪一件事，其实是可以先不还的？
en: Which one thing lately could you actually leave unpaid for now?

zh: 给自己排一段 15 分钟什么都不做的时间。不为恢复效率，只是允许停下。
en: Give yourself 15 minutes of doing nothing. Not to get more efficient afterwards, just to allow stopping.
This sounds like {{name}}. I am here.

zh: 你已经说出来了，这本身就是一步。我不会评判你。
en: You already said it out loud, and that is a step in itself. I will not judge you.

zh: {{name}}常常不是身边没有人，而是「说了也没用」这个预设挡在前面。
en: {{name}} is often not about having nobody around. It is the assumption that saying it would not help, standing in the way.

zh: 你最想被接住的，是这件事本身，还是「有人愿意听」这件事？
en: What you most want held: the thing itself, or the fact that someone is willing to listen?

zh: 如果现在能找一个人，你脑子里第一个出现的是谁？
en: If you could reach one person right now, who comes to mind first?

zh: 如果想找真人，我可以给你几条 24 小时都有人接的电话；如果只想被听见，继续在这儿说就行。
en: If you want a real person, I can give you a few lines that are answered 24 hours a day. If you only want to be heard, keep talking here.

zh: 我读到的是{{name}}。我想先不下这个判断。
en: What I read is {{name}}. I want to hold off on that judgement for now.

zh: 听起来你在拿这件事给自己定论。我先不下这个判断。
en: It sounds like you are using this to conclude something about yourself. I want to hold off on that judgement.

zh: 自责常常是「我很在意这件事」的另一面。它指向的是你心里的标准，不是你的能力——把这两件事分开看会清楚一些。
en: Self-blame is often the other side of caring a lot about this. It points at the standard you hold, not at your ability. Separating the two makes it clearer.

zh: 如果是朋友做了同一件事，你会怎么对他说？
en: If a friend had done the same thing, what would you say to them?

zh: 把「我不好」换成「这件事没成」，那句话还成立吗？
en: Swap I am not good for this one did not work out. Does the sentence still hold?

zh: 把这件事写成「事实」和「我对事实的评价」两栏，先只看事实那一栏。
en: Write this in two columns, facts and what I made of the facts, and read only the facts column first.

zh: 你说不上来具体是什么——要不要先给它一个临时的名字？
en: You cannot say exactly what it is. Would you give it a temporary name first?

zh: 说不清也是一种清楚：它说明那里确实有东西。
en: Not being able to name it is also a kind of clarity: it means something is really there.

zh: 如果先给它一个临时的名字，你会叫它什么？
en: If you gave it a temporary name first, what would you call it?

zh: 这些只是基于你这句话的一版读法，不是给你的定性。哪一句不准，你说一句，我就改写它。
en: This is only one reading built from this one line of yours, not a verdict on you. Tell me which line is off, and I will rewrite it.

zh: 还没读到明显的情绪信号。要不要先给它一个临时的名字？
en: No clear emotional signal came through yet. Would you give it a temporary name first?

zh: 信息还不多，这一步我只做命名，不做解读。
en: There is not much to go on yet, so this step only names it. I will not interpret it.

zh: 昨天我们聊到过它。如果你想再往里走一层，可以点「引导我看看」。
en: We touched on this yesterday. If you want to go one layer deeper, you can use the Guide me through it button.

zh: 边界：我只读到你这一句话和最近 14 天的聚合值，看不到昨天那件具体的事。
en: One limit: I only have this one line from you and the 14-day aggregates. I cannot see the specific thing that happened yesterday.

zh: 这一句话里读到的线索：
如果愿意，说一件你做了、但没人提起过的事——哪怕它很小。
en: If you feel like it, name one thing you did that nobody mentioned, even if it was small.

zh: 这听起来是委屈。被忽略的付出也是付出，它不是矫情。
en: This sounds like grievance. Effort that went unseen is still effort. This is not oversensitivity.

zh: 我先把读法摆在前面：这是目前我更愿意相信的一种读法，也完全可能是另一种：你今天只是太累了。
en: Let me put my reading up front: this is the one I lean toward right now, and it could just as well be the other one, that you are simply very tired today.

zh: 委屈常常指向「被看见」这个需要
en: grievance usually points to the need to be seen

zh: 有人在项目收尾时被一句「这个谁都能做」带过，让他难受的不是那句话本身，是前面三个月晚走的事一次都没被提过。愤怒对着外面，委屈对着自己，两样常常叠在一起。
en: Someone had three months of late nights go unmentioned, then was brushed off at the end of a project with anyone could have done it. What hurt was not that sentence, but all the work nobody ever named. Anger faces outward, grievance faces inward, and the two often stack.

zh: 先不急着开下一件：花一分钟说清楚，是哪一小部分让你最兴奋。
en: Do not rush into the next thing yet: spend a minute getting clear on which small part excited you the most.

zh: 真好，这种时刻值得被记下来。它值得被特意存一个副本，不只因为好，还因为有用：低落的时候，这一页能当证据用。
en: It is good, and a moment like this is worth writing down. It deserves its own copy, not only because it is good but because it is useful: on a low day, this page works as evidence.

zh: 看清是哪一部分让人兴奋，比记住「今天挺好」更耐用
en: seeing which part caused the excitement lasts longer than just remembering that today was fine

zh: 有人做成一件事后只写下「今天不错」，三个月后再看完全想不起是什么在起作用；后来他改成写「下午那两小时没人打断」，低落时照着这个条件去复现，比任何鼓励都管用。
en: Someone wrote only today was good after finishing something, and three months later could not recall what actually did it. Later they wrote those two undisturbed hours in the afternoon instead, and on low days recreating that condition worked better than any encouragement.

zh: 这份情绪可能在说什么
en: What this feeling may be saying

zh: 已跳过这一次的引导。七天内我不会再主动提起，你想聊的时候，「引导我看看」一直都在。
en: Skipped this check-in. I will not bring it up on my own for seven days. When you feel like talking, the Guide me through it button is always there.

zh: 已关闭自动引导。你仍然可以随时点「引导我看看」主动开始。
en: Automatic guidance is off. You can still start one yourself at any time with the Guide me through it button.

zh: 随时主动开始一次情绪觉察引导
en: Start an emotion check-in yourself at any time

zh: 在你说到明显的情绪时，除了正常回应，再给一次结构化的情绪觉察引导：先命名，再读它可能指向的需要，最后留一个问题。它随时可以在卡片里关掉。
en: When you mention a clear emotion, this adds one structured check-in on top of the normal reply: name it first, then read what it may be pointing to, then leave one question. You can turn it off inside the card at any time.
